name: Aika Enhanced
author: hatewxb (Aika), NVHT (Steam Enhanced Friends dock)
description: Aika, a warm dark theme for Steam (Fluent structure, file-system-style panels and soft spots of light on a near-black background), with a Friends Dock and its built-in chat on every page, and Steam Enhanced's Millennium Settings.

Color preset.description: The theme color set: the accent and the light spots. To set colors manually, turn on "Custom colors" in the "Color set" tab.

Top bar.description: Where the Store, Library, Community and profile tabs sit in the top bar.

Compact header.description: Compact: the menus, the tabs and the account buttons share one line.

Header wordmark.description: The "Aika" name at the top left of the window: the classic serif, calligraphy, or アイカ in katakana with a brush.

Preloader.description: The "Sign in to Steam" window shown while Steam starts. Classic: the cover grid in your preset's hue and a comet ring. Terminal: falling hex glyphs and the Aika logo. Horizon: a glowing planet rim. Orbits: bits circling the mark. Aurora: soft aurora sheets. Frame: a beam running round the window and a heartbeat of dots. Glitter warp: a starfield flying out of the mark. All follow the color preset; seen at the next Steam start.

Wallet visibility.description: The wallet balance next to the account name in the top bar.

URL visibility.description: The address capsule over store and community pages, top left (takes a Steam restart to reach the pages).

What's New visibility.description: The "What's New" shelf at the top of the library home.

Add Shelf visibility.description: The "Add shelf" row at the bottom of the library home.

Steam News visibility.description: The Steam news (megaphone) button in the top bar.

Friends background.description: The pattern behind the friends list: a halftone wave of dots, softly blinking squares, or only the light spots. Drawn at a few frames a second, paused while the window is hidden; one still frame on Performance: Low.

Friends background opacity.description: How visible the pattern behind the friends list is.

Offline friends.description: The friends list's offline group: a grid of faces (the name shows on hover) or Steam's list.

Friend search.description: The search in the Friends tab. Magnifier: a round button that stretches into a field when clicked. Command line: always a field, monospace, with a "›" prompt and the number of friends found.

Friends list layout.description: Only the list density: regular or compact. As in Steam keeps Steam's density setting. Game banners are controlled separately below.

Friends game banners.description: Show game artwork and compact game/lobby cards in the friends list. Off uses plain Steam rows and group headings, keeping names, game status and party information.

Friends Dock.description: A friends column at the right edge of the window, beside the library, the Store and the Community: your Steam friends in game and online, with their games and unread messages. Collapsed it is a rail of faces, expanded a list with names; a click opens the chat, a right-click the menu. Off: the window as in Aika, with no room left for it.

Dock at startup.description: How the dock looks when Steam starts. Last state: as you left it (expanded or collapsed). Expanded or Collapsed: always so at startup; the button at the top of the dock still switches it. On a narrow window the dock folds to its rail anyway.

Expand on hover.description: The collapsed rail opens over the library while the cursor rests on it and folds back when it leaves (the library keeps its width).

Dock: friends in game.description: The “In game” group: friends playing something, with the game's name.

Dock: friends online.description: The “Online” group: friends online and not in a game (away and snooze included).

Dock: offline friends.description: An “Offline” group at the end, folded until you open it, last seen first.

Dock: group by game.description: Friends in game grouped under each game (its icon, name and how many play it) instead of one list.

Dock: friend count.description: How many friends are online at the top of the dock and in each group.

Dock animations.description: The dock's own motion: the width and the library room easing, names fading in, faces growing under the cursor, new friends rising in. Performance: Low turns it off too.

Dock: in the library.description: The dock beside the library: home, collections, a game's page.

Dock: in the store.description: The dock beside Store pages (store.steampowered.com): the page narrows to make room.

Dock: in the community.description: The dock beside Community pages (steamcommunity.com): profiles, the Workshop, inventories, the Market, discussions.

Dock: on other pages.description: The dock beside the other pages of the main window: Support, news, Downloads and the rest.

Dock width.description: The width of the expanded dock, in pixels.

Dock avatar size.description: The size of the friends' faces in the dock, in pixels; the collapsed rail is as wide as a face and its padding.

Dock opacity.description: How solid the dock's background is: 0 % is the same see-through surface as the game list on the left, 100 % an opaque panel body. The colors are the preset's.

Built-in chat.description: A click on a friend opens the chat beside the dock, Steam Enhanced's way: Steam's own chat (history, sending, pictures, stickers, emoticons, invites, typing) in a flyout, in a popup over Store and Community pages. Off: Steam's chat window, as before.

Chat window button.description: A button in the chat's corner that moves the conversation to Steam's own chat window. A friend's menu offers it too.

Unread badges.description: How many messages wait, on each friend's face in the dock.

Message alerts.description: A new message makes its badge pulse once. Steam's own message notifications stay as set in Steam's settings.

Scroll to new messages.description: The open conversation follows a new message even when it is scrolled up. Off: Steam's own scrolling (it follows only at the bottom).

Keep the open chat.description: The open conversation stays when the dock folds, when you go to another page and across a Steam restart (it comes back minimized). Off: folding the dock or leaving the page closes it.

Navigation layout.description: Where My Profile (your avatar, its ring showing your status), Settings, Games, Announcements and Notifications sit — Steam Enhanced's navigation in Aika's look. Top Bar: in the header's row, menus drop under them. Left Sidebar: a narrow rail at the left, menus open beside it. Downloads and Aika's other buttons stay where they are. Switches at once.

Performance.description: How much the theme moves on its own. Full: everything as designed (the default; already tuned to cost as little as it can). Balanced: fewer moving elements on and around items — no light following the cursor around store blocks and library panels, no shimmer on Play, no glares or light sweeps, 3D tilt covers lift instead, the Cinematic description stays still, the background light spots stand still; menus, hovers, page transitions, trailers, the store backgrounds (30 frames a second) and the glass notifications stay. Low: no Aika motion and no heavy effects at all — every look stays, but nothing the theme added moves (only Steam's own animations remain); the light spots are one still picture, no backdrop blur, no glass on notifications, no animated store backgrounds, no trailers playing behind the Cinematic page.

Store.description: The layout of a game's store page. Cinematic: the trailers play muted over the whole window behind the logo, price and buttons, with a media gallery below; the editions and everything else stay as in Classic. Needs theme scripts.

Library scrolling.description: Mouse-wheel motion in the left library game list only. Standard (default): Steam scrolling. Soft: optional short, smooth easing. Cinematic: optional longer glide with short, fading motion trails away from the cursor; the area around the cursor stays sharp. Keyboard and scrollbar dragging stay native; Low performance and reduced motion use Standard.

Library covers.description: How game covers in the library (Home shelves, collections) react to the cursor. 3D tilt: the cover turns toward the cursor in 3D with a moving glare. Lift: it rises a little. Zoom: the art zooms in its frame with a glare sweep.

Cover press.description: What a library cover does while you hold the mouse button on it. Press: it sinks a little. Ripple: rings of accent light run out from the press point. Charge: an accent line runs round its edge and the cover lights up once it closes. Off: nothing.

Cursor glow.description: A soft accent glow under the cursor on large library blocks (game page panels, What's New, collections).

Cursor glow radius.description: The size of the cursor glow, in pixels.

Privacy blur.description: Blurs the wallet balance (or the account name and the balance) in the top-right account button until you hover over it; inside its menu the login and the balance are blurred until hovered — handy for streams and screenshots.

Notification wordmark.description: Background wordmark on notification toasts: Gothic, brush-style Aika, katakana アイカ like the header, or Off. Glass and abstract lights remain in every option.

Notification opacity.description: How much a notification covers the desktop: lower is more transparent.

Custom colors.description: Use your own colors instead of the preset. The colors themselves (accent, accent hover, three light spots) are on the "Colors" page right below.
